title: OpenCode (@opencode) on X
excerpt: We had a security breach last night related to a large scale distillation attack that impacted 1.4% of OpenCode Console users We have notified them all this morning via email The incident is ongoing so we cannot share more details at this point but we are working with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Googl…
content_html: We had a security breach last night related to a large scale distillation attack that impacted 1.4% of OpenCode Console users We have notified them all this morning via email The incident is ongoing so we cannot share more details at this point but we are working with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google to remediate
